Granulomatous Mastitis: The histopathological findings of granulomatous inflammation, fibrous and lymphoid tissue infiltrated by large epithelioid granulomas with central acellular necrosis, and many giant cells are consistent with granulomatous mastitis. The absence of microorganisms on special stains and the presence of granulomas in the sentinel lymph node support this diagnosis.

However, the frozen section and gross examination revealed granulomatous inflammation, which may indicate an alternative diagnosis.
